name: Steel connections — bolting, welding, fabricated details
description: Join beams, columns, bracing and equipment supports by shop/site welding and high-strength bolting; seismic designs require predictable yield and ductility at connections. Primary source: https://americansteelandaluminum.com/resources/materials/a992-steel

specifications.basis: A992 is prequalified base metal under AWS D1.1; normally E70 series low-hydrogen filler by SMAW/FCAW/GMAW/SAW; preheat per D1.1 tables; heavy flanges >2 in need access-hole grinding + MT/PT
ASTM A615 Note 3: welding should be approached with caution; latest AWS D1.4/D1.4M recommended for filler selection and preheat/interpass
